address: 25/236 Mu 6, Soi Had Chaweng 5, Tawirat Phakdi Road, Bo Phut, Ko Samui, 84320, Thailand
bio: The restaurant upholds authentic Southern Thai food thanks to a culinary repertory that is hard to find elsewhere. One example is the delectable local squid in sweet coconut milk soup with a hint of lemongrass. The daily fish menu changes according to the catch of the day. If available, the deep-fried whole pomfret topped with spicy Southern Thai curry is highly recommended. They offer indoor and outdoor dining with plenty of parking....
